messages:
Sasha Li: Raised a docs PR to document resolver fallback behavior for colocated Private installs. Need: minimal CoreDNS conf for conditional forward + DoT upstream, short rollback/migration steps for installs that used /etc/hosts, and two one-liner smoke tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1289 :mag:

docs-bot: PR created by Sasha Li: redwood-inference/docs #1289 - `resolver-fallback & split-dns examples` (CI running)

Thomas Reed: Thanks. Two asks: 1) show explicit ordering (stub -> internal forwarders -> upstream DoT) as a bullet, 2) mention interaction with systemd-resolved and how to avoid conflict (use stub listener port or nftables redirect).

Priya Kapoor: Can we include a tiny CoreDNS config that uses conditional forwarding for kms.svc.cluster and a generic DoT upstream? Also call out the minimum CoreDNS version for the `tls_servername` option.

Sasha Li: Dropping a compact CoreDNS snippet here — meant for copy/paste into the docs examples section. Will add an inline note about CoreDNS >= 1.10.

Sasha Li: "```
.:1053 {
    tls 
    forward kms.svc.cluster 10.42.0.5 10.42.0.6
    forward . 9.9.9.9 149.112.112.112 tls_servername=dot.provider.example
    cache {
        success 600
        denial 30
    }
    log
}
```"

Ivan Lopez: Suggest adding simple validation commands in the docs:
`dig @127.0.0.1 -p 1053 kms.svc.cluster A`
`openssl s_client -connect dot.provider.example:853 -servername dot.provider.example`
Also note: for appliances behind NAT, recommend binding CoreDNS to 127.0.0.1 and using nftables DNAT for port 53.

Priya Kapoor: For the migration paragraph, propose these steps: 1) remove /etc/hosts entries that pointed to internal services, 2) enable installer flag `--use-local-stub`, 3) apply CoreDNS forwarders, 4) run smoke tests and roll back if resolution fails. Link to infra migration script: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/migrations/remove-host-hacks (internal).

Thomas Reed: Tiny wording change: use `Private (colocated)` in user docs instead of `colocated Private` so it reads better. Also call out NXDOMAIN caching policy for kms.svc.cluster — we should keep `denial` low (30s) to avoid stale negative results.

Sasha Li: Added your edits and pushed an update to the PR. I also included a one-line troubleshooting checklist at the top: "1) confirm stub listening, 2) confirm forwarders, 3) verify DoT upstream, 4) revert hosts if needed."

docs-bot: CI checks passed for #1289 1 tests, link-check OK.

Ivan Lopez: I spun up the sample in staging (edge-colo-3) and validated both fresh install and hostfile->stub migration. All green except a corner case where systemd-resolved captured port 53 on Ubuntu 22.04 images. Documented workaround: `systemd-resolve --set-stub-resolv 127.0.0.53` or use the nftables redirect example.

Sasha Li: Great, thanks Ivan. Merging once the changelog entry is added. I'll add a short release note referencing `--use-local-stub` and the migration script.

Sasha Li: Merged after changelog added. Closing the thread.
